about: Racking product families whose maker sells them as BALLASTED (held down by weight, not attached through the roof), read by backend/src/ballastRacking.ts. Plan sets often name the product ('UNIRAC RM10 EVO', 'ECOFOOT2+') without ever writing the word 'ballast', so the product name is evidence on its own. Each pattern is matched on the text upper-cased with every run of non-letters/digits turned into one space, as whole words: write it in that form ('RM10 EVO', not 'RM10-EVO'). A family whose maker sells both ballasted and attached versions under one name does not belong here: name only the ballasted model. Adding a product is a record here, never code.

products.family: RM ballasted roof mount (RM10, RM10 EVO, RM5, RM DT)
